title: CTAB–Chloroform DNA Extraction from Ethanol-Preserved Freshwater Phytobentos
author: Pavla Urbankova
materials: Carefully decant the supernatant without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Resuspend sample
steps.instruction: Manually shake the ethanol‑preserved sample container until particulates are fully homogenized.

steps.title: Transfer homogenate
steps.instruction: Pipette 2 mL of the homogenized ethanol mixture into a 2.0 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Centrifuge pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13 500 rpm, room temperature, for 20 minutes (max speed).

steps.title: Dry pellet
steps.instruction: Dry the pellet for 00:10:00 (10 min) using either a vacuum concentrator or a heat block (open cap) to remove all ethanol.

steps.title: Add CTAB buffer
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL CTAB buffer (room temperature) to the dried pellet.

steps.title: Vortex CTAB mix
steps.instruction: Vortex continuously for 00:15:00 (15 min).

steps.title: Freeze sample
steps.instruction: Freeze at –20 °C until fully frozen (typically 01:00:00); samples may be stored at –20 °C overnight and processed the next day.

steps.title: Add Proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add 4 µL (or 20 µL) Proteinase K (20 mg/mL) and vortex briefly.

steps.title: Incubate with Proteinase
steps.instruction: Incubate at 65 °C for 01:00:00 (1 hour).

steps.title: Add chloroform
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL chloroform and mix gently with the pipette tip.

steps.title: Phase separation centrifuge
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13 500 rpm, room temperature, for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Collect aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Carefully transfer ~300 µL of the upper aqueous phase to a new 2.0 mL or 1.5 mL tube using a fresh filter tip, avoiding the interphase.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL ice‑cold isopropanol (stored at –20 °C) and mix by inverting the tube several times.

steps.title: Cold incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate for 00:15:00 (15 min) at 4 °C.

steps.title: Pellet DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13 500 rpm, room temperature, for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully discard the supernatant without losing the pellet.

steps.title: First ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL ice‑cold 70 % ethanol (stored at –20 °C) and briefly vortex.

steps.title: Centrifuge wash
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13 500 rpm, room temperature, for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Repeat ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the ethanol wash once more:

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL ice‑cold 70 % ethanol (stored at –20 °C) and briefly vortex.
Centrifuge at 13 500 rpm, room temperature, for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Final drying
steps.instruction: Dry the pellet (open cap) for ~00:10:00 (10 min) in a vacuum centrifuge or on a 65 °C heat block, avoiding airborne contamination.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Dissolve the DNA pellet in 30 µL EB buffer (or sterile milliQ water), vortex, spin down, and let the DNA dissolve for at least 1 hour before further analysis (or store in fridge/freeze).
